rows.note: Use 部分 as the all-purpose noun for a part of a whole, including a relatively small part.

example.english: Only a small fraction of this report is unfinished.
example.traditional: 呢份報告得返一小部分未做完。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 dak1 faan1 jat1 siu2 bou6 fan6 mei6 zou6 jyun4

rows.note: Use 分數 specifically for a mathematical fraction written with a numerator and denominator.

example.english: The math teacher asked me to write three-quarters as a fraction.
example.traditional: 數學堂老師叫我將四分之三寫成分數。
example.jyutping: sou3 hok6 tong4 lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 zoeng1 sei3 fan1 zi1 saam1 se2 sing4 fan6 sou3
